original_target.title: Symmetric capacity of the binary multiplying two-way channel

scope_comparison: The exact adaptive vanishing-error symmetric rate remains between unequal known bounds in primary Kim lecture/Tandon literature. An older Schalkwijk1985 converse abstract claims .63056 optimal, but later primary1995 construction achieves .63072, so the old exact-capacity claim is not a valid settlement. Nonadaptive/zero-error/secrecy channels differ.
